function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The Best Men’s Underwear Styles (and When to Wear Them) | Style | Description | Pros | Cons | Ideal Use | |-------|-------------|------|------|-----------| | **Briefs** | Classic “tight” cut that covers the hips and buttocks. | • Excellent support
• Great for high‑impact activities
• Minimal fabric for hot days | • Can feel restrictive
• Not ideal for long trips if you’re prone to chafing | Everyday wear, gym, running, cycling | | **Boxers** | Loose, wide‑cut with a relaxed fit. | • Breathable
• Comfortable for lounging
• Good for people who dislike compression | • Less support
• Can bunch up under tight pants | Sleep, casual wear, travel | | **Boxer Briefs** | Hybrid of briefs and boxers – snug but with a bit more room. | • Combines support and breathability
• Versatile for many activities
• Reduces friction | • Still can feel tight for some
• May not be as breathable as pure boxers | Everyday wear, sports, travel | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than boxer briefs, similar support. | • Modern look
• Good for low‑rise pants
• Less bulk | • Limited coverage for those who prefer longer legs | Fashionable everyday wear, low‑rise jeans | | **Thongs** | Minimal coverage, no rear panel. | • No visible panty lines
• Lightweight
• Great for tight clothing | • Not suitable for all body types
• Can cause discomfort if not fitted properly | Low‑line pants, swimwear, when you want zero lines | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight, elastic waistband, often with a built‑in brief. | • Excellent muscle support
• Reduces vibration
• Ideal for endurance sports | • Very tight fit
• Not for casual wear | Running, cycling, hiking, sports | | **Performance Fabrics** (e.g., moisture‑wicking blends) | Made from synthetic fibers designed to pull sweat away. | • Keeps you dry
• Quick‑dry
• Often odor‑resistant | • Can feel less natural
• May require special care | Sports, hot climates, travel | | **Organic Cotton / Bamboo** | Natural fibers with eco‑friendly production. | • Soft, breathable
• Hypoallergenic
• Sustainable | • Can be pricier
• May shrink if not cared for properly | Everyday wear, eco‑conscious consumers | | **Modal / Tencel** | Semi‑synthetic fibers derived from wood pulp. | • Extremely soft
• Moisture‑absorbent
• Durable | • Can be expensive
• Requires gentle washing | Everyday wear, sensitive skin | --- #### How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **High‑impact sports** → Briefs or compression shorts. - **Low‑impact or sedentary** → Boxers or boxer briefs. 2. **Think About Comfort & Fit** - **Tightness**: Too tight can cause chafing; too loose can lead to bunching. - **Waistband**: Look for a smooth, elastic waistband that doesn’t dig into the skin. 3. **Material Matters** - **Cotton**: Breathable but can absorb sweat. - **Synthetic blends**: Moisture‑wicking, quick‑dry. - **Natural fibers**: Soft, hypoallergenic, eco‑friendly. 4. **Style & Fashion** - **Low‑line jeans**: Trunks or boxer briefs. - **Visible panty lines**: Thongs or seamless briefs. 5. **Travel & Longevity** - **Durable fabrics**: Modal, Tencel, or performance blends. - **Easy care**: Look for machine‑washable, wrinkle‑resistant options. --- #### Trending Underwear Styles (2024) - **Seamless Boxer Briefs**: No seams for a smooth look under tight pants. - **Eco‑Friendly Lines**: Brands using recycled polyester or organic cotton. - **Tech‑Infused Fabrics**: Anti‑odor, UV protection, and temperature regulation. - **Bold Prints & Colors**: From subtle stripes to vibrant patterns for a fashion statement. --- #### Quick Tips - **Try Before You Buy**: If possible, test the fit in-store or order from retailers with easy return policies. - **Check the Care Label**: Some performance fabrics need cold water and gentle cycles. - **Layer Wisely**: For colder climates, pair a lightweight cotton or modal layer with a moisture‑wicking base layer. --- **Bottom Line:** The “best” underwear style depends on your personal comfort, activity level, and style preferences. For most men, a mix of boxer briefs for everyday wear, briefs for sports, and boxers for sleep or travel offers the best versatility. Experiment with different materials and fits until you find what feels like a second skin.
